metadata.description: easyClaude - a stack-agnostic harness for building real projects with Claude Code.

plugins.name: easyclaude
plugins.description: Persistent project state, an enforced verify gate, safety guardrails, stack recipes, and a one-shot cheap mode.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: A file tree beside the conversation, coloured by git, that shows which files Claude reads and changes. By Kurt Buhler (MIT), a companion to easyClaude.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds a risky command, such as rm -rf or git reset --hard, and shows what it would delete before you press Proceed or Cancel. From Anthropic's playground (Apache-2.0), adapted for Windows; a companion to easyClaude.
